definition: The volume of the solid swept out when a region is rotated one full turn ($2\pi$ radians or $360^{\circ}$) about an axis: for the region between a curve and the $x$-axis rotated about the $x$-axis it is $\int_{a}^{b} \pi y^{2}\,\mathrm{d}x$ with $x$-values as limits, and for the region between a curve and the $y$-axis rotated about the $y$-axis it is $\int_{a}^{b} \pi x^{2}\,\mathrm{d}y$ with $y$-values as limits.
